# opnsense_telegraf_input (Resource)

Telegraf input plugins (**Services ▸ Telegraf ▸ Input**, plugin `os-telegraf`): which metrics the agent collects. This is a singleton: import it with the ID `telegraf_input` before managing it. Attributes left unset keep their current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_telegraf_input.this
  id = "telegraf_input"
}

resource "opnsense_telegraf_input" "this" {
  cpu = true
  pf  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `apcupsd` (Boolean) Enable the collection of apcupsd metrics.
- `apcupsd_server` (String) IP address or hostname of the apcupsd net information server. Default address is 127.0.0.1.
- `collect_cpu_time` (Boolean) If true, collect raw CPU time metrics.
- `cpu` (Boolean) Read metrics about CPU usage.
- `cpu_percpu` (Boolean) Whether to report Per-CPU stats or not.
- `cpu_totalcpu` (Boolean) Whether to report total system CPU stats or not.
- `disk` (Boolean) Read metrics about disk usage by mount point.
- `disk_ignore_fs` (String) Ignore some mountpoints by filesystem type. For example (dev)tmpfs (usually present on /run, /var/run, /dev/shm or /dev).
- `disk_mount_points` (String) By default, Telegraf gather stats for all mountpoints. Setting mountpoints will restrict the stats to the specified mountpoints.
- `diskio` (Boolean) Read metrics about disk IO by device.
- `haproxy` (Boolean) Enable the collection of HAProxy statistics.
- `internet_speed` (Boolean) Enable the collection of data about the internet speed on the system.
- `internet_speed_interval` (Number) Default internet speed test interval in seconds. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `internet_speed_saving` (Boolean) Not recommended if speed tests work. Reduces memory and computation needs, but accuracy is compromised at connections above 30Mbps.
- `intrusion_detection_alerts` (Boolean) Requires intrusion detection alerts are stored locally.
- `mem` (Boolean) Read metrics about memory usage.
- `network` (Boolean) Read network interface metrics.
- `ntpq` (Boolean) Enable the collection of NTP query metrics.
- `ntpq_dns_lookup` (Boolean) Can increase metric gather times.
- `pf` (Boolean) Read PF values via pfctl.
- `ping` (Boolean) Ping hosts using IPv4 and measure the metrics.
- `ping6` (Boolean) Ping hosts using IPv6 and measure the metrics.
- `ping6_count` (Number) Number of ping packets to send per interval. Corresponds to the "-c" option of the ping command. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `ping6_hosts` (String) Set the hosts to ping using IPv6 in a CSV list.
- `ping_count` (Number) Number of ping packets to send per interval. Corresponds to the "-c" option of the ping command. `-1` when unset; set `-1` to clear it.
- `ping_hosts` (String) Set the hosts to ping using IPv4 in a CSV list.
- `processes` (Boolean) Get the number of processes and group them by status.
- `swap` (Boolean) Read metrics about swap memory usage.
- `system` (Boolean) Read metrics about system load and uptime.
- `unbound` (Boolean) Enable the collection of Unbound metrics.
- `zfs` (Boolean) Enable the collection of ZFS statistics.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `telegraf_input`.
